period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. (Bonus Solo cross-check figures are detailed in the notes below and are NOT used as this file's own line_items, which remain Consolidated throughout for internal consistency.) Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. DUPLICATE-FILE FINDING: the bank's financial-reports page links a SEPARATE row captioned 'Q3, 2015' to the file PBL_3rd_Quarter_Financial_Statements_2015-scaled.jpg -- but that file is BYTE-IDENTICAL (MD5 5deffbdf2cfcb1644713baa106ef7b6c, same 1006905-byte size, same 2560x2029 dimensions) to THIS Q1-2016 file. The bank's own website has mislabelled/duplicated the upload, so the 'Q3 2015' download slot on the live site does not actually contain Q3 2015 data -- it silently serves this Q1 2016 statement instead. Genuine Q3 2015 data was not found anywhere else (see sources.json) and is recorded as a gap, not fabricated from this mislabelled duplicate. BONUS SOLO CROSS-CHECK (from this file's own 'Price sensitive information' box, Solo Position column): NAV Mar-2016 1,059.93 crore / Mar-2015 916.37 crore; NAVPS Mar-2016 17.09 / Mar-2015 16.26; EPS Mar-2016 0.21 / Mar-2015 0.40; NOCFPS Mar-2016 0.51 / Mar-2015 0.46 -- all genuinely different (higher EPS, in this case) from this file's own Consolidated figures (EPS 0.16), confirming the Solo/Consolidated split is real and material even though only the per-share metrics are available on a Solo basis here (no Solo balance sheet or full P&L).
